front.title: Apple confirms 'Welcome Home' product launch for October 13
front.tldr: Apple has confirmed a product launch for Tuesday 13 October, expected to focus on new smart home hardware rather than a traditional keynote event.

front.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
front.tldr: Google is turning Gemini into an agent that can plan and execute tasks across business apps, delegating work to subagents and drawing on multiple AI models.

front.title: Ben Affleck's new Netflix thriller 'Animals' premieres to mixed reviews
front.tldr: Ben Affleck directs and stars opposite Kerry Washington in 'Animals', a Netflix kidnapping thriller echoing Kurosawa's 'High and Low', out now to mixed reviews.

stories.title: Natura's $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
stories.tldr: Natura has launched a $99 Interface smart ring that summons AI agents with a press of the finger to complete tasks, capture notes or control devices, while also tracking health.

stories.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
stories.tldr: Ben Affleck has gone viral for his detailed knowledge of neural networks and open-weight models, surprising viewers given he sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix last year.

stories.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1 billion in 10 months
stories.tldr: The company behind the LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and is now also measuring AI models on alignment issues such as lying.

stories.title: Goodfire's new 'inside-out' monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
stories.tldr: Goodfire has launched monitors that peek inside a model as it works, rather than paying a second AI to review everything it does, to catch rogue agents more cheaply.

stories.title: ttok 0.4 released, Simon Willison's CLI token counter
stories.tldr: Simon Willison has updated ttok, his command-line tool for counting tokens with OpenAI's tiktoken library, fixing a warning and refreshing it after a few years untouched.

stories.title: The Atari 800XL hybrid gaming console is back after decades in obscurity
stories.tldr: A revived Atari 800XL connects via HDMI and ships with 25 built-in games, bringing the 1980s hybrid computer-console back decades after it fell out of production.

stories.title: Forza Horizon 6 is coming to PS5 on January 26
stories.tldr: Forza Horizon 6 is heading to PS5 on 26 January, with the racing game's first expansion also due early next year.

stories.title: Ex-con founder builds Commissary Club to help people leaving prison find work
stories.tldr: Richard Bronson, a former Stratton Oakmont partner who served federal prison time for securities violations, has launched Commissary Club, using AI to help people leaving prison find jobs.

stories.title: Alexa Tablet vs iPad Pro: how Amazon is keeping up with Apple
stories.tldr: Amazon's latest high-end tablet shares several design similarities with Apple's iPad Pro, though the two differ in the detail, according to a hands-on comparison.

stories.title: Spotify is getting more serious about selling enterprise software
stories.tldr: Spotify has launched technology.spotify.com, a new site making its internal engineering tools available for other companies to buy and use.

stories.title: Apple to launch touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro and OLED iPad mini on October 27
stories.tldr: Bloomberg reports Apple will introduce touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro models and an OLED iPad mini around 27 October, alongside a new M6 14-inch MacBook Pro.

stories.title: Apple Home adds two powerful new features in iOS 27
stories.tldr: iOS 27 brings two new features to Apple's Home app, arriving ahead of a run of smart home product launches expected next week.

stories.title: Tim Cook explains why he stepped down as Apple CEO before the iPhone Duo launch
stories.tldr: Tim Cook told The Independent's David Phelan, in an interview at Apple's UK headquarters, why he chose to step back from the CEO role before the iPhone Duo's launch.

stories.title: You can now use TextExpander for free across Mac, iPhone, iPad and more
stories.tldr: Keyboard shortcut utility TextExpander now offers a free plan, giving users its core Snippets feature across Mac, iPhone, iPad, Windows and Chrome.

stories.title: Alfonso Cuarón reflects on making 'Harry Potter': 'two of the most beautiful years of my life'
stories.tldr: At a Busan Film Festival masterclass, Alfonso Cuarón reflected on lessons from 'Children of Men' and learning to put life before cinema.

stories.title: 'Crazy Rich Asians' series ordered at HBO with film's original cast returning
stories.tldr: HBO has ordered an hour-long 'Crazy Rich Asians' drama series, with co-writer Adele Lim as showrunner and executive producer and the 2018 film's original cast returning.

stories.title: TCM is sticking around under Skydance, to be overseen by the film group instead of TV
stories.tldr: Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein will oversee TCM going forward, after Mike De Luca and Pam Abdy previously led the classic film channel at Warner Bros.

stories.title: Matthew Lillard on resenting 'Scooby-Doo' after his career stalled when the sequel flopped
stories.tldr: Matthew Lillard said he expected 'Scooby-Doo' to launch a bigger career, and had to sell his house and downsize after the franchise's sequel underperformed.

stories.title: Luka Garza headlines Celtics win over the Cavaliers, 124-113
stories.tldr: Boston opened its preseason with a 124-113 win over Cleveland, with Luka Garza leading the way while the Celtics rested their top players.

stories.title: Russell and Antonelli to race with different specs amid Mercedes upgrade concern
stories.tldr: George Russell will race Mercedes' older-specification car in Singapore while Kimi Antonelli runs the upgraded package, as the team tries to work out why the updates have underperformed.

stories.title: Oscar Piastri: Red Bull has become 'the class of the field' in F1 2026
stories.tldr: Oscar Piastri now rates Red Bull alongside Mercedes as Formula 1's strongest team, as McLaren loses ground after Red Bull's significant upgrade to the RB22.

stories.title: FIA introducing measures to avoid 'software bug' chaos repeat
stories.tldr: The FIA will introduce further changes to wet-weather engine software from the United States Grand Prix, after a review into the bug that delayed last week's race start.

stories.title: Actor Nick Offerman praises his 'son' Payton Tolle for his baseball antics and moustache
stories.tldr: Nick Offerman praised Red Sox pitcher Payton Tolle, who has embraced comparisons to Offerman's Ron Swanson character, for his moustache and on-field personality.

read.why: With Google turning Gemini into an agentic coworker today, Lenny's guide to folding AI agents into product management lands right on time.
read.title: Make product management fun again with AI agents
read.subtitle: A guide to AI agents for product managers

listen.why: A timely refresher on writing ads that sell, straight from Damian's own trade of product marketing and persuasion.
listen.title: #430 How to Write Ads That Sell

listen.why: As Apple reshuffles its leadership around John Ternus, Doug Leone's take on great founders starting over late in their careers feels timely.
listen.title: Doug Leone on Sequoia, Fear, Great Founders & Starting Over at 69

listen.why: A deep dive into the NFL's business empire, good background for a Patriots fan ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders.
listen.title: The NFL

finally.title: Margaret Hamilton, who led Apollo's onboard software team, dies at 90
finally.tldr: Margaret Hamilton, who led the 100-person team that wrote the onboard software guiding Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin to the Moon, has died aged 90.
